description: Use this when the user wants a technical headshot checklist and crop recommendations for LinkedIn, XING or job applications. Returns static recommendations, not official platform upload limits; no image input or external network access. No persistent changes; operational call metadata is logged. Do not use for assessing an actual image or confirming platform acceptance. The image is analysed in memory and not stored. It does not generate images, video or audio or return edited images. It does not judge attractiveness, identity, age, gender, ethnicity or any other personal attribute; no face recognition or biometric identification.

target.description: Destination for crop recommendations: linkedin, xing, application or all (default). Example: linkedin. All includes every destination.
